dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Mina. This is my first day here.

explanation: 처음 만난 사람에게는 Nice to meet you.가 자연스러워요.
친근한 안부 What's up?에는 Nothing much.처럼 가볍게 답할 수 있어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I haven't eaten anything all day.

explanation: 매우 배고플 때 I'm starving.이라고 말해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I should get going. See you next week!

explanation: 헤어지며 상대의 안녕을 바랄 때 Take care!를 사용해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ___ Could you tell me how to get to the station?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Go straight for two blocks.

explanation: 낯선 사람에게 말을 걸거나 질문하기 전에는 Excuse me.가 적절해요.
